{{Quote|Su'cuy gar, vod. What brings me the honor of having Mandalore's chosen in my camp?|Vorten Fett, speaking to a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]|audio=VortenFett-MandalorsChosenInMyCamp-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR:AM" />}}
'''Vorten Fett''' was a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] Commander in the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He served as the skilled [[Military rank/Legends|military]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Mandalorian encampment on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], leading a thousand warriors on the planet under the payment of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Interestingly unlike many of his fellow Mandalorians, he held nothing against the young warrior [[Torian Cadera]], seeing much promise in him and was saddened to see him go missing as a result.<ref name="TOR:IB">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Imperial Bounty|Taris}}</ref> Later he accompanied [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] as part of the emergency war council gathered to discuss [[Darth Malgus]]' [[New Empire]].<ref name="SWTORAEB">{{TORcite|type=general|An Empire Betrayed|Ilum}}</ref>
{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
Vorten Fett wore yellow [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] and kept a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] at his hip on all times.

==Behind the scenes==
Vorten Fett first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]] and was voiced by [[Tom Kane]]. He is part of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] class story.<ref name="TOR:AM" /> He also appears during the Ilum quest line.<ref name="SWTORAEB" />
